_about: Curated reference timeline of events that moved traffic, freight or transport revenue in India. This is a starting chronology for justification narratives, NOT a citation. Every entry must be verified against a primary source before it goes into a study. Edit freely, add your own rows in the same shape.

_fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM where only the month is meaningful
_fields.end: optional end date for events with duration
_fields.title: short name of the event
_fields.kind: macro | policy | environment | social | geopolitical | sector
_fields.mechanism: how it reached transport, the bit you actually need for a narrative
_fields.verified: true only where the date has been checked against a source

events.title: Global financial crisis
events.mechanism: Export orders and industrial output fell sharply; commercial vehicle traffic and port container volumes dropped through FY09 before recovering from late FY10.

events.title: Commonwealth Games, Delhi
events.mechanism: Large NCR road and metro capacity commissioned around the event; temporary restrictions and lane reservations during the Games period.

events.title: Supreme Court ban on iron ore mining in Karnataka
events.mechanism: Ore movement to Goa and Krishnapatnam collapsed. Heavy commercial vehicle counts on the Bellary-Hospet corridors and connecting highways fell steeply and did not recover for years.

events.title: Goa iron ore mining suspension
events.mechanism: Ore truck traffic on Goa state highways and barge movement on the Mandovi and Zuari effectively stopped; Mormugao port throughput fell heavily.

events.title: Uttarakhand floods
events.mechanism: Char Dham route highways washed out at multiple points; pilgrim traffic to Kedarnath and Badrinath fell for several seasons. A long reconstruction programme followed.

events.title: Crude oil price collapse begins
events.mechanism: Brent fell from about 110 to under 50 dollars by early 2015. Diesel cost dropped, road freight rates softened, and commercial vehicle utilisation improved.

events.title: Diesel price deregulation
events.mechanism: Diesel moved to market pricing, linking road freight cost directly to crude and the exchange rate from this point onward.

events.title: Chennai floods
events.mechanism: Highways and rail into Chennai cut for days; airport closed; port operations disrupted. A sharp one-month dip in regional traffic series.

events.title: Bharatmala programme takes shape
events.mechanism: Large national highway development programme announced, driving the award pipeline and, over the following decade, substantial new parallel capacity on many corridors.

events.title: Demonetisation, toll collection suspended nationwide
events.mechanism: MoRTH suspended user fee collection on all national highways from 9 November to 2 December 2016. NHAI reported a loss of roughly Rs 1,238 crore against an average daily collection near Rs 51.6 crore. Any FY17 revenue series will show this hole; traffic itself also fell as cash-dependent trucking slowed.

events.title: GST rollout
events.mechanism: State check posts dismantled. Truck turnaround times improved materially, raising effective vehicle utilisation. Freight patterns reorganised around consumption centres rather than tax boundaries.

events.title: E-way bill for inter-state movement
events.mechanism: Created a national record of goods movement. Useful as a demand proxy in forecasting, and it shifted some informal freight into the formal count.

events.title: Revision of axle load norms
events.mechanism: Permissible gross vehicle weights raised by roughly 20 to 25 per cent. Same tonnage moved in fewer trips, so tonne-km rose while vehicle counts at plazas softened. Watch this carefully when comparing pre and post 2018 AADT.

events.title: Kerala floods
events.mechanism: State highways and NH stretches submerged, Kochi airport closed for two weeks, rail services suspended. Regional traffic series show a deep single-month trough.

events.title: Kumbh Mela, Prayagraj
events.mechanism: Very large pilgrim inflow lifted passenger vehicle counts on corridors feeding Prayagraj for the duration, with heavy restrictions on commercial vehicles in the approach zone.

events.title: Cyclone Fani
events.mechanism: Odisha coastal highways and rail links disrupted; Bhubaneswar airport closed. Short but severe regional traffic loss.

events.title: Commercial vehicle sales downturn
events.mechanism: A sharp fall in CV sales through FY20 signalled weakening freight demand ahead of the pandemic. Useful as a leading indicator in back-testing forecasts.

events.title: COVID-19 national lockdown, toll collection suspended
events.mechanism: Toll collection on national highways was suspended from 25 March and resumed on 20 April 2020. Traffic fell to a small fraction of normal, recovering unevenly through FY21 with freight ahead of passenger movement. This is the single largest discontinuity in any Indian traffic series.

events.title: Cyclone Amphan
events.mechanism: Severe disruption across West Bengal and Odisha during lockdown, compounding the traffic trough.

events.title: Farmers' protest. Delhi border blockades
events.mechanism: Sustained blockades at Singhu, Tikri and Ghazipur diverted traffic off NH-44, NH-9 and NH-48 approaches to Delhi for over a year. Plazas on affected approaches show prolonged depressed volumes, and some were kept free.

events.title: FASTag made mandatory
events.mechanism: Electronic tolling became compulsory at national highway plazas. Transaction data quality improved sharply from this point, which matters when comparing pre and post 2021 plaza records.

events.title: COVID-19 second wave
events.mechanism: State-level restrictions rather than a national lockdown. Traffic fell again but less deeply than 2020, with wide variation between states.

events.title: Coal supply crisis
events.mechanism: Power plant coal stocks fell critically; railways prioritised coal rakes over other freight, pushing some cargo to road.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine war begins
events.mechanism: Crude and fertiliser prices spiked, lifting road freight costs. Trade flows reorganised, including discounted crude imports that raised tanker and pipeline-adjacent movement at west coast ports.

events.title: Record wheat export surge then ban
events.mechanism: A brief export boom lifted grain movement to ports, followed by an abrupt export ban that reversed it. A clean example of policy whiplash showing up in port hinterland traffic.

events.title: Joshimath subsidence
events.mechanism: Land subsidence forced restrictions on the Char Dham route and a pause on some construction, affecting pilgrim season traffic in the Uttarakhand hills.

events.title: Cyclone Biparjoy
events.mechanism: Kutch and Saurashtra highways and Kandla port operations disrupted; short sharp regional dip.

events.title: Sikkim glacial lake outburst flood
events.mechanism: NH-10, the lifeline to Sikkim, was severed at multiple points. Long-duration loss of the only practical road access, with repeated closures in following monsoons.

events.title: Red Sea shipping disruption begins
events.mechanism: Attacks on shipping forced rerouting around the Cape, lengthening transit times and raising container freight rates. Indian EXIM cargo timing shifted, affecting port-connecting highway and rail flows.

events.title: Mumbai Trans Harbour Link opened
events.mechanism: Atal Setu opened, redistributing traffic between Mumbai and Navi Mumbai and changing approach volumes on competing routes. A textbook diversion event.

events.title: General election
events.mechanism: Model code of conduct froze new announcements and awards. Expect a gap in the project pipeline across this window rather than a genuine slowdown in activity.

events.title: Wayanad landslides
events.mechanism: Severe hill road loss in Kerala, with extended closure of local connectivity and a reminder of monsoon risk on Western Ghats alignments.

events.title: Maha Kumbh, Prayagraj
events.mechanism: Exceptionally large pilgrim movement over six weeks. Passenger vehicle counts on feeding corridors rose steeply while commercial traffic was restricted or rerouted.
